result.title: Projector Time Map Calibration for Event-based Structured Light
result.comment: accepted to IEICE Transactions on Information and Systems
result.summary: Existing event-based structured light obtains a dense projector-camera correspondence from the timestamp of an event. It assumes that the projector scans a parallel raster and that the sensor timestamps each pixel independently, and we show that neither assumption holds. We obtain the correspondence from a temporal code that identifies the projector pixel directly and therefore needs no prior calibration, we calibrate the projector time map from the same recording, and we recover the geometry of the system and the offsets between its clocks by a spatio-temporal self-calibration in a preamble of a few seconds that needs no reference object and no second camera.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对事件相机结构光系统，指出投影仪扫描与逐像素时间戳假设不成立，改用直接标识投影仪像素的时间码，并从同一段记录中自标定投影仪时间映射、系统几何与时钟偏移。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于事件相机—投影仪几何与时钟标定的硬件系统工作，虽涉及「时间码」与自标定，但未触及 VLM 内部状态、视觉证据使用、推理停止或训练监督，缺少可供 LVR 借鉴的具体线索，故排除。
